sentences.text: Ron Abbott died on May 9th.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she was married to Ron for 52 years.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated Ron won prizes for his dahlias at the show.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she cannot keep up the garden maintenance now that Ron is gone.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she cannot get into the bath and now performs a strip wash at the sink.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she goes up the stairs on her bottom some days.
Karen Wells (S3) stated her mother nearly fell on the landing in October.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she bruised her arm after the fall but did not go to hospital.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she does a bit of soup and a sandwich for meals, noting she is not one for cooking for one.
Karen Wells (S3) stated Doreen Abbott (S2) eats what she brings and had all her dinner the previous day.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she wants to stay at home with Ron's things.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she is long, quiet, and has nobody to talk to since Ron died.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she would be better off dead.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she has been putting by about 40 tablets since the summer, saving them without taking them.
Karen Wells (S3) stated she found the tablets on Sunday, hidden in a bedside drawer in an envelope under hankies, and took them home in her bag.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she has no other tablets saved elsewhere in the house.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she is eating what Karen brings, but disclosed that if she were put in a home, she would stop eating.
Gareth Lloyd (S1) provided the crisis line number 116 123 and instructed Doreen Abbott (S2) to ring Karen or this number if she feels like that again, especially at night.
Doreen Abbott (S2) confirmed she would call the crisis line if she felt like that again.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she has her own pension and a council benefit from her late husband Ron, and that Karen handles bills on the computer.
Karen Wells (S3) stated they sorted the bank account after Ron's funeral and that Doreen is fine for money.
Doreen Abbott (S2) expressed a wish to see Dr Patel.
Karen Wells (S3) agreed to sort the weekly medication packs with Kestle Pharmacy.
Doreen Abbott (S2) agreed to attend the lunch club at St Anne's on Wednesdays.
Gareth Lloyd (S1) agreed to refer for a stairlift assessment and a bath seat.
Gareth Lloyd (S1) agreed to ask about a morning carer for washing.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she does not want a carer every day.
Gareth Lloyd (S1) stated he would ring Dr Patel's surgery when he left that afternoon.
Karen Wells (S3) agreed to take the saved tablets to the pharmacy today.
Gareth Lloyd (S1) stated he would do the stairlift referral by Friday and return on Tuesday, 1st December.
